description:
Check an address BEFORE ordering (takes a few seconds). For a title search (report_type 'current_owner', the
    default) give `state` and `county`: it matches the address to a real parcel in the county's records. For
    report_type 'environmental' only the address is needed: it is matched with the US Census geocoder (any US address).
    status 'matched' = safe to order; 'not_found' = ask the user to correct the address; 'not_covered' = the county is
    not covered; 'unavailable' = the county / Census service is down right now (a title search can still be ordered
    and retries; an environmental order needs the geocoder, so try again later).
name: check_address
